_comment: Example baseline.json — this is what ~/ForestVault/baseline.json looks like after the first swarm cycle. Real values will reflect your system. Replace example.com IPs with what netstat actually shows on your machine.

_port_notes.443: HTTPS — local dev server or system proxy
_port_notes.1080: SOCKS proxy — may be from VPN client
_port_notes.3000: Node/React dev server — present only when developing
_port_notes.5000: Flask/Python dev server — present only when developing
_port_notes.11434: Ollama API — always present when Ollama is running

processes._notes: 406 processes on a typical macOS developer machine. Only the names are stored, not PIDs — PIDs change every reboot. New processes that appear in subsequent cycles are flagged as [DELTA] items for the LLM to examine.

_how_to_use: This file is auto-created on the first swarm cycle — you don't need to create it manually.
